decisions.reason: As a basic organic staple, it retains real option value in a growing segment and is cheap to keep while uncertainty remains.
Organic Kasseler is a niche variant with limited traction after three years, and its option value no longer justifies the cost of keeping it.
Organic pepper salami fits existing production and benefits from broader organic demand, making the option worth holding with low keeping cost.
The exotic teriyaki aspic specialty has very low market appeal and high uncertainty resolved unfavorably, so the option should be abandoned.
Despite a dedicated launch page, fennel salami has not shown sustained traction and its niche flavor limits further upside, so the option is unlikely to gain value.
Liver pâté with veal faces a declining traditional category and poor revealed value after three years, making abandonment the likely real options decision.
